text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has entered its final phase.
Alongside regular training, she has also taken
ballet lessons, and as a result—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Haaaaah!!

"With added flexibility on top of her powerful push-off,
she's become able to stride forward with effortless extension.
And most importantly—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to run one more time!
There's still way too much tension in my fingertips!
choice_data_list: Got it, let me catch my breath and we'll go again!

text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia was growing capable of understanding and moving
every inch of her body. If she keeps grasping her body's rhythm like this—
choice_data_list: (I can unleash everything at the perfect moment!)

text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Call Shion!
âUnderstood!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! That's gorgeous...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yeah. In terms of total body awareness, I'd say you passed!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Though, this is just my take on it...
For now—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Let's find out in the race!!!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, allow me to take a look.
Thank you in advance."
choice_data_list: Please! And thank you all for your help!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"It's totally fine~"
"Well, it's for Epi's sake after all..."
"We're fated to be together, after all♪ Fufu."

To showcase Epiphaneia's evolved running,
we had the teacher come over once again to hold a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Haaaaaaaaaaaaaa...!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right, O voice of destiny!
Not here. Not yet."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the power surging through my body!!
...The moment to unleash all these feelings is—

text_block_list.name: Epi & Voice of Fate
text_block_list.text: "RIGHT HERE!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhh!!

I pumped my fist into the air without thinking.
Epiphaneia's run was—flawless.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: “—I've overlaid it with the data collected earlier. The vector of your power flows beautifully in sync with your running rhythm.”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I felt it too!
The flow of power surging through me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
With this—there's no need to hold back!
I can let it explode at the perfect moment!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Maybe I'll go watch the race, too.

This eases the concern about Epiphaneia
losing control. All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"It's an afterparty!!
Cheers!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Cheers!
Cheers.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: C-Cheers...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Is it really okay for me to be here?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for helping me, everyone!
Thanks to you, I've gotten even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely gonna win the Kikuka Sho!
And not just win—I'm gonna show everyone the most awesome victory ever!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So that everyone watching will feel destiny at work!
Look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Man, honestly,
you're always brimming with confidence, huh.
choice_data_list: Because that's what's great about Epi.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right.
Epi-san believed in herself to make it that far..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "Guess I'd better start giving it my all soon, too."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Cesario!
I want you, in particular, to watch closely!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'll run with everything I've got for your sake too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah...
Due to her injury, Cesario hasn't been racing on the front lines since the autumn of her Classic year. She is likely taking that into account.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Epi, we're here~!" "Good evening!"
"You're gonna treat us for that practice race,
aren't you~?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone!!
Thanks a lot!!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Epi-san,
you intend to carry my burden as well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
She's quite headstrong, but...
she truly looks out for others, too...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
She's a nice person.
—She's a good kid.
choice_data_list: （…This time, I'll turn that kindness into strength.）

text_block_list.text:
That gentle feeling of caring for everyone was one cause of running wild before.
But I won't—let it end like that ever again.

A short while after that...
Called over by Epiphaneia, I quietly slipped away from the after-party.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, pretty sure it's this way!
The voice of destiny says so too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!
It's so quiet...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...
Yeah, the voice of destiny is right after all!
choice_data_list: After all, you brought me here.
After all, you brought me here.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's not all.
—It brought you into my life.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You worked so hard
for my sake, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"You thought so much about it,
and even took ballet lessons for me..."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You've run alongside me
all the way here!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! You're my partner.
Because it's us—we can definitely do it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So,
let out what's inside your heart.

Startled, I reflexively clutched my chest.
There lay the proof of my resolve
to guide her—my letter of resignation.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know what it is!
I just had a gut feeling that got me curious!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Even at the summer festival,
you were clutching your chest.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I know! It was probably something you needed to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Still, I don't need any of that! What I need—is you yourself!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So, hand it over.
Bet on me instead!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Your resolve, your hopes, your dreams!
Believe in me as an Umamusume who can carry them all!

Put that way, I had no choice but to hand it over.
Refusing would mean I didn't trust her.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Here I come!
—Hah!

Epiphaneia tore the paper into tiny pieces—
Reflecting the moonlight, they danced softly through the air
like out-of-season cherry blossoms.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...You were the very first human
I ever felt a sense of destiny with.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
To me, you are—
a truly special person. Far more than you realize!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I promise you. At the Kikuka Sho,
I'll make you feel that ultimate destiny, too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"So never think about leaving again!
From here on out—let us walk together!"

Toward the fateful Kikuka Sho—
everything was set.
